name: How long does it take to replace corroded pipes?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace corroded pipes?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of corroded pipe replacement can vary significantly based on the project's scope. A minor repair involving a single corroded section might take only a few hours. However, a whole-house re-piping project, especially in larger homes, could take several days to a week. Factors like the number of affected pipes, their accessibility, and the type of new piping material chosen can all influence the timeline. During our initial consultation, we provide a projected timeline tailored to your specific situation, helping you understand what to expect. We work efficiently to restore your plumbing with minimal interruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Timing varies from a few hours for minor repairs to several days for whole-house re-piping. Factors include scope, accessibility, and pipe material.
